Blue Ridge Capital Increased Alibaba Group Hldg LTD (BABA) Position by $6.00 Million as Valuation Rose; As Banc Of California (BANC) Stock Declined, Forest Hill Capital Has Upped by $700,000 Its Stake
May 21, 2018 - By Winifred Garcia
Mark Lee increased its stake in Banc Of California Inc (BANC) by 5.51% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Forest Hill Capital Llc bought 35,000 shares as the company’s stock declined 11.29% with the market. The hedge fund run by Mark Lee held 670,673 shares of the finance company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $13.85M, up from 635,673 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Forest Hill Capital Llc who had been investing in Banc Of California Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $948.65 million market cap company. The stock decreased 0.27% or $0.05 $18.75. About 402,570 shares traded. Banc of California, Inc. (NYSE:BANC) has declined 9.16% downtrending. It has underperformed by 20.71% the S&P500.
John Griffin increased its stake in Alibaba Group Hldg Ltd (BABA) by 18.86% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Blue Ridge Capital Llc bought 34,900 shares as the company’s stock rose 3.18% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by John Griffin held 219,900 shares of the business services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $37.92M, up from 185,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Blue Ridge Capital Llc who had been investing in Alibaba Group Hldg Ltd for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $501.05 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.52% or $1.02 $195.
